messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a per-customer flag enable for BlueSky (Enterprise VIP) to validate contract-gated billing + allowlist. Targeting ~10% of org users (≈12 seats). Canary today 14:00 PT, full rollout Wed AM. Need signoffs: entitlements, allowlist provisioned, rate-limit guardrails, and a verified kill-switch. Tagging @maria @sam @jen for infra/SRE/contract checks. Ops playbook: add tenant to tenant_allowlist, set feature_flag 'bs_vip_2026' = true for org_id=bs-42, and ensure fallback to model-small when overloaded. Any blockers?

maria: I can provision the allowlist now. Quick Q — do you want the tenant-level flag only, or also a per-user opt-in toggle inside the org?

alex: tenant-level only for the canary. If the canary is healthy we'll add per-user in the next pulse. Thanks. Also: please set the tracing tag `tenant=bs-42` and flag metadata `owner=alex,canary=10pct`.

sam: For the canary percentage we can set the rollout via the flag-service:

```
# rollout command
flagctl set bs_vip_2026 --org bs-42 --percent 10 --meta "owner=alex,canary=10pct"
```

Also: recommend rate-limit of 60 rps per org during canary, with a circuit-breaker threshold at 200ms p95 latency.

jen: Contract gating check: confirm the invoice + SLA match VIP entitlements. I'll run a quick query to ensure billing tier is correct. If billing tag `vip_contract=true` is missing, we should block the toggle.

alex: Good call. Kill-switch path (if anything goes wrong):

```
# immediate kill switch
flagctl set bs_vip_2026 --org bs-42 --percent 0 --force
# fallback to model-small (automatic via routing rule)
routingctl set-priority bs-42 model-small
```

I'll also add an alert runbook entry. Tagging ops to watch traces and error counts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by alex at 2026-03-18T14:00:00-07:00. CI: green, canary window 30m. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/bs-vip-canary-1788

maria: Allowlist provisioned and tenant flag key created: org_id=bs-42, flag_key=bs_vip_2026. Applied by maria at 13:20 PT. Verified via `flagctl get bs_vip_2026 --org bs-42`. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll have SRE watch p95, error-rate, and queue depth. Suggested guardrails: 60rps org cap, 5s overall timeout, autoscale threshold CPU>70% on inference-pool. If we hit the circuit-breaker I'll trigger the kill-switch. :eyes:

jen: Please drop the code review link here (CR + changelog) and add a short note to the support runbook so CS knows the canary audience. Also we should gate on `vip_contract=true` — if that tag isn't present, flagctl should refuse to enable.

alex: CR is https://git.internal/r/8452 — includes the contract-gate check and allowlist handling. Owners: alex (release), maria (allowlist), sam (SRE monitoring), jen (contract verification + support comms). I'll create the incident channel #inc-bs-vip-canary and ping oncall at start. Back in 30m to confirm green.

sam: Ack. I'll join #inc-bs-vip-canary at start and watch the metrics dashboard. If anything spikes I'll flip the kill-switch and post the reason. :thumbsup:
